verdict.rationale: Jev is a typed-decision model API, and an API platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling, cron, or recurring workflow features. Retry policies, batching many questions into one call, and async clients are one-off request mechanics, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
